class.name: JRPGLocalHost
class.brief_description: The event host of a game played on this machine.
class.description: Carries out what events ask of the world through the [JRPGSceneManager] that created it ([method JRPGSceneManager.get_local_host]): transfers go through [method JRPGSceneManager.transfer]. Authority: server (a single-player game is its own server).
